description: This file defines the BackupClient class within the Aws\Backup namespace, which serves as a client for interacting with the AWS Backup service via the AWS SDK for PHP. It declares a series of methods related to backup operations, which are documented through PHPDoc annotations, but the class itself is empty, extending only AwsClient.

classes.name: BackupClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with AWS Backup service, extending the generic AwsClient class and providing method signatures for backup operations.
